excerpts: When you give Claude a task, it works through three phases: **gather context**, **take action**, and **verify results**. These phases blend together.
The agentic loop is powered by two components: [models](#models) that reason and [tools](#tools) that act.

The summary keeps your requests and key code snippets, but detailed instructions from early in the conversation may be lost. Put persistent rules in CLAUDE.md rather than relying on conversation history.
